title: computeBaseline must skip context-map-cover, ownership-fresh, reports-index-fresh
body: devx/lib/arch/core.mjs computeBaseline skips api-index-fresh only; `tl arch --update-baseline` can grandfather a stale OWNERSHIP table, an unmapped file or a stale REPORTS digest. Reported by builders of cards 6 and 7.

title: arch step paths miss report-cited files: --changed skips a stale REPORTS digest
